subject: [hw] IK start: relay minor, 0299 patch assembly, compile check
body: IK here (integrator K). Files: kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec_relay.inc (minor 1 "redwood-vcodec-client" 0666, MSG_SEND/RECV on both minors, DMA access rule), kern/bsd/dev/sweet_touch.c.patch + make_patch.sh -> 0299, compile_check.sh, INTEGRATION.md, test_ik/**. K01/K02 are not in kern/ yet (11:15); I build the relay against a registered hardware-ops struct and test it with a host shim, then assemble 0299 and run the staged compile when their .inc files land. Contract post to hw-k02 follows.
